english.title: Racially / religiously aggravated fear of violence - writing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) distributed or displayed to **(..SPECIFY PERSON OR ANOTHER..) a writing, sign or visible representation which was threatening, abusive or insulting with intent to cause that person to believe that immediate unlawful violence would be used against

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

or another by any person, or to provoke the immediate use of unlawful violence by that person or another, or whereby that person was likely to believe that such violence would be used or it was likely that such violence would be provoked, which was racially or religiously aggravated in accordance with section 28 of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(1)(a) and (4) of the Crime and Disorder Act 1998.

investigatoraction.description: Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This CJS Code and Standard Offence Wording is OBSOLETE. Now see CJS Code CD98066 and Offence Wording H10003.

(i) The option to return an alternative verdict of guilty of the basic offence is NOT available in the magistrates court, therefore the basic offence should be charged in addition to the aggravated offence.
(ii) If, on trial on indictment the jury find the defendant not guilty of the offence charge, they may find him guilty of the basic offence under Section 4 of the Public Order Act 1986.
(iii) For the racially or religiously wordings see offence wordings: H2802 and H4732.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
